name: MH3G #30 Bowgun current/source magazine candidate
purpose_zh: 在弩系换弹状态变化中验证备用分支 0x02856D7C 的 r7 玩家状态、+0x45A 当前装填、+0x45B 来源/上限、+2 武器类型和 +0x45D 弹种索引。只记录，不修改。
purpose_en: During a Bowgun reload-state transition, prove r7 player state on alternate branch 0x02856D7C, current magazine +0x45A, source/capacity +0x45B, weapon type +2, and ammo subtype +0x45D. Record only; do not modify state.
operator_steps_zh: 分别为轻弩和重弩准备一组装填数已知、可正常换弹的弹种；每次 trace 只使用其中一种武器和一种弹。
打空或消耗至少一发，启动 tracer 后只执行一次标准换弹，不切弹、不换装、不使用自动装填技能。
轻弩与重弩各完成一次独立命中；确认 r7+2 类型值、+0x45D 弹种索引、+0x45B 满装填数和 +0x45A 当前值与 HUD 一致后才可升级。
operator_steps_en: Prepare one normally reloadable ammo type with known capacity for both Light and Heavy Bowgun; use only one weapon and one ammo type per trace.
Spend at least one round, start the tracer, and perform exactly one standard reload without switching ammo, changing equipment, or enabling an auto-reload skill.
Obtain independent hits for Light and Heavy Bowgun. Promote only after r7+2 type, +0x45D ammo subtype, +0x45B full capacity, and +0x45A current count agree with the HUD.
